thread.title: WayvePay surpasses 100,000 customers, expands digital offerings
thread.title_full: WayvePay surpasses 100,000 customers, expands digital offerings

author: GuardianNigeria
title: WayvePay surpasses 100,000 customers, expands digital offerings
text:
WayvePay, the digital banking platform of Wayve Microfinance Bank, has surpassed 100,000 customers less than a month after its rebranding.
, the digital banking platform of Wayve Microfinance Bank, has surpassed 100,000 customers less than a month after its rebranding. The milestone marks a significant step in the platform’s growth and ambition to make everyday banking, payments and financial services more accessible to Nigerians, its Head, Corporate Communications and Marketing Manager, Kingsley Ezenwa, said in a statement.
Ezenwa said the milestone came shortly after the platform transitioned from Bankit to WayvePay, introducing a broader digital financial proposition under its new positioning. The transition, which took effect on September 18, 2026, represents more than a change of name and identity, as the platform is also expanding its technology, functionality and range of services, the statement said. Ezenwa said the 100,000-customer milestone represented both the progress made by the platform and the opportunity ahead.
“Crossing 100,000 customers is an important milestone for WayvePay, but we see it as the beginning rather than the destination. Our ambition is to build a financial platform that becomes part of how Nigerians move, save, spend, grow and manage their money every day,” he said. The milestone follows WayvePay’s recent expansion of its customer proposition and comes at a time when Nigerians are increasingly adopting digital channels for everyday financial transactions.
WayvePay’s proposition also extends into investment and financial opportunities, including access to the share offer through the platform, giving eligible Nigerians an opportunity to participate in the ownership of one of the country’s major industrial projects.
